improvement_suggestion: T3 partial — before committing to a long training run, assess over-parameterisation risk: N_examples vs model size. A 24B parameter model trained on 8130 examples will overfit unless the training task is highly structured (it was not — creative JOI content has infinite surface variation). A simple heuristic: if N_examples < 0.1% of model parameters, treat as memorisation risk rather than style-learning opportunity. For seigei's next training attempt, either (a) use a much smaller base model, (b) collect 10x more diverse training data, or (c) lean on prompt engineering + RLHF rather than supervised fine-tuning.
